firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently ate chocolate goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: That player takes the starting player marker and fills the Factory displays during setup. They then put the marker in the center and take the first Factory offer turn; play continues clockwise.
During each round, the first person to take tiles from the center also takes the marker into their foundry line. It counts for the foundry penalty and makes them the next round’s starting player.
The brown-board and Special Factories variants retain the same initial starting-player criterion.

internalEvidence: Complete publisher-hosted or publisher-linked PDF retrieved; relevant setup, opening-turn, variant and edition pages read and visually inspected. Reviewed PDF pages: 1, 2, 4, 5, 6. The publisher-owned Next Move CDN supplies this six-page PDF in a non-cover-first order. Printed page 2 selects the latest chocolate eater; printed page 3 places the marker in the center before their clockwise first turn. The center taker receives the marker later, with the foundry penalty, and begins the following round. Both variants preserve the initial criterion. The final-score horizontal-line tie-break is not a starting-player rule. The cover identifies Master Chocolatier and the credits say ©2022 despite the 2024 hosting path.
